name: Loss Aversion Framing (Prospect Theory)
scenario: Enterprise software representative pitching an observability platform to an IT executive struggling with legacy system outages.
script: "Every month you delay deploying this automated observability infrastructure, your firm burns $85,000 in unrecoverable server waste and exposes your enterprise to compliance fines of up to $300,000 per incident."
defense: Deflect the loss frame: legacy maintenance is provisioned; do not accelerate procurement on hypothetical loss models.
originFull: Prospect Theory shows that individuals exhibit asymmetric valuation between gains and losses: the subjective pain of an economic loss is psychologically valued at 2 to 2.5 times the pleasure of an equivalent gain.
defenseFull: Deflect the loss frame back to operational fundamentals: "We have fully provisioned for the maintenance overhead of our legacy infrastructure. We will not accelerate our procurement cycle based on hypothetical loss models; we evaluate this tool purely on verifiable ROI."
